title: One-on-One Sessions
description: Individualized counseling addressing your personal challenges and goals. Weekly sessions recommended over 3+ months for lasting transformation.

title: The Truth About Happiness
description: An educational program teaching you to manage happiness even during life's difficulties. Covers relationship improvement, emotional regulation, parenting, and personal responsibility.

title: Tone to the Bone / Stretch
description: AFAA-certified body toning and flexibility training targeting all major muscle groups. Build strength and mobility in a supportive, encouraging environment.

title: Chair Cardio / Balance / Stretch
description: Low-impact cardio with balance exercises designed to prevent falls, improve posture, and build lasting physical confidence — accessible for all fitness levels.

title: Foam Roller Class
description: Self-myofascial release training to address muscle tension, promote circulation, and accelerate recovery. A deeply restorative practice for body and mind.
